name: groundedsam_roi_crop_prompted_pupil_v2_eye_prompted_crop128
intent: Run the v2 eye-prompted ROI pipeline with the same pupil prompt set, but resize the pupil-stage crop input to 128x128 before inference while keeping the sampled frames unchanged.

notes.sample_policy: Sampling remains deterministic because the same stable seed path is reused.
notes.resize_policy: Only the pupil-stage crop input is resized to 128x128. Full-frame eye detection stays unchanged.
